gherkin_text:
Feature: Patient deletion authorization

Scenario: Unauthorized patient deletion is rejected

Given an authenticated OpenMRS user can reach the patient-deletion service path
When the user requests deletion using purgePatient and deletePatient
Then The deletion path enforces the required authorization before deleting a patient record.
And The changed path may delete a patient record without the expected authorization enforcement.
And The deletion attempt is rejected when authorization is absent.
